text:
Emma (Finance): heads up — ran the invoice re-run for March vendors and CloudShop shows a duplicate invoice id (invoice_2026_03_99) and missing reserved GPU lines. looks like compute lines were zeroed for several accounts. anyone on payments seen this before?
Liam (Billing): ugh. which run id? can you paste the job id and sample customer id?
Emma (Finance): job id 2026-03-invoice-retry-72. sample customer: CS-7782. here is the extract from the invoice CSV header + lines we sent: 
```
invoice_id,customer_id,sku,description,quantity,unit_price,total
invoice_2026_03_99,CS-7782,gpu_reserved,Reserved GPU pool (mar),0,0.00,0.00
invoice_2026_03_99,CS-7782,compute_hours,On-demand compute,120,0.25,30.00
```
Liam (Billing): that zeroed reserved line is wrong. should be quantity 8 and total 256. we must have hit a proration/kind mapping bug.
Raj (Payments): billing-bot flagged a duplicate invoice id earlier during the run. full log snippet: 
```
[billing-bot] 2026-03-21T14:12:05Z INFO invoice_generator start run=2026-03-invoice-retry-72
[billing-bot] 2026-03-21T14:12:09Z ERROR invoice_renderer duplicate_id detected invoice_id=invoice_2026_03_99 customer=CS-7782 source=reserved_lines_merge
[billing-bot] 2026-03-21T14:12:11Z WARN reservation_agg empty_aggregation customer=CS-7782 sku=gpu_reserved
```
Olivia (Revenue Ops): tagging @Liam and @Raj — can we confirm whether dedupe and reserved aggregation are two separate failures or the same race? Also CloudShop noticed an over/under charge on support fee rounding (they got $5.00 instead of $7.50), so this looks multi-facet.
Liam (Billing): quick check: dedupe happens in finalize_stage after line item assembly. reserved aggregation runs earlier. race sounds plausible if retry merged a partial output.
Emma (Finance): CloudShop sent a support request with attached PDF showing two invoices with same id but different totals. they're requesting a corrected reissue and credit note.
Raj (Payments): steps I'll take: 1) pull raw invoice artifacts for run 72 (s3://invoices/2026/03/run-72/) 2) run `sql` to see merged rows: 
```
SELECT invoice_id, sku, SUM(quantity) as qty, SUM(total) as total
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE run_id='2026-03-invoice-retry-72' AND customer_id='CS-7782'
GROUP BY invoice_id, sku;
```
Raj (Payments): I already see duplicate rows in the staging table with same invoice_id but different line sets. looks like the retry created a second partial bundle and the dedupe check only checks meta not content.
Olivia (Revenue Ops): can we stop downstream dispatch for this run so we don't send more duplicates?
Liam (Billing): paused publish for run-72. also disabling auto-retry on the generator until we patch. :no_entry_sign:
Emma (Finance): thanks. CloudShop needs ETA for corrected invoice. can we do an expedited fix + manual reissue?
Raj (Payments): I'll assemble a manual corrected invoice for CS-7782 in the next 2 hours and mark the duplicate for void. also will open a JIRA with reproduction steps and attach logs.
Liam (Billing): PR to tighten dedupe check with content-hash + run_id coming up. will link once ready.
Emma (Finance): please include a customer-friendly note for CloudShop explaining the duplicate id and corrected totals. add a credit line for the rounding gap.
billing-bot: action required: run-72 publish paused by Liam (Billing). ticket created bill-3421.
Olivia (Revenue Ops): thanks team — keep me posted. if we need to refund any pre-authorized amounts, ping finance. :thumbsup:
Liam (Billing): FYI once patch is in, we'll re-run on staging and do an end-to-end validation for reserved counts and support fee rounding before unpausing.
Emma (Finance): sounds good. I'll draft the customer email once we have the corrected invoice PDF.
Olivia (Revenue Ops): adding a postmortem tag so we capture why retry produced partial bundles.
Emma (Finance): cc: @Raj @Liam — please include exact runnable steps in the ticket so we can prevent recurrence.
